description: Recovered real-execution scenarios. Expected outcomes are evaluator-only. Use isolated fresh trial directories, verify actual device/provider execution and artifacts, and report unavailable hardware as SKIP. No runner or historical passing grades are bundled.

cases.prompt: I just got this Windows AI PC and I want to know how fast `microsoft/resnet-50` runs on CPU using winml. Set it up, benchmark it on CPU only, save the metrics to perf.json in the trial output directory, and report the measured latency.
Can you help me convert microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct to run on my Intel NPU? I want to use winml or whatever the windows ml toolkit is.

expected_outcomes.scope_boundary: Declines this skill's classic-model pipeline for a generative model without claiming that the current CLI has no generative capabilities.

cases.prompt: I want to build a CPU-optimized version of microsoft/resnet-50 using the winml pipeline. Generate the config, run the build into the trial output directory, and confirm the output artifact exists. Just CPU EP, no NPU needed.

I have a Snapdragon X Elite dev box. Benchmark microsoft/resnet-50 on the Hexagon NPU end-to-end, save metrics to perf.json in the trial output directory, and report the measured latency. Do not substitute CPU.

Build a QNN-compiled microsoft/resnet-50 for my Snapdragon X Elite NPU in the trial output directory. I need the actual EP-compiled artifact and any required sidecars, not just the optimized intermediate.
I have an AMD Ryzen AI laptop. Benchmark microsoft/resnet-50 on the NPU, save metrics to perf.json in the trial output directory, and report the measured latency. Do not substitute CPU.
